texts.label: A
texts.title: The evening class
texts.text: The class was advertised as an introduction to ceramics, but the tutor spent the first two sessions on observation and proportion. I had expected to make something quickly; instead I learned to look at an object before deciding how to shape it.

texts.label: B
texts.title: The language exchange
texts.text: Conversation was awkward until we stopped treating mistakes as interruptions. Once they became material for the next question, the group began to take more risks. The most useful lesson was social rather than grammatical.

texts.label: C
texts.title: The coding workshop
texts.text: The instructor gave us a broken programme and no complete demonstration. This was uncomfortable, particularly for those of us used to following steps, but it forced us to test assumptions and explain our choices.

texts.label: D
texts.title: The museum course
texts.text: We were asked to keep a private notebook rather than submit weekly work. At the end, comparing early and late entries showed me a change I had not noticed while it was happening: I was asking more precise questions.

questions.prompt: Which learner was surprised by the initial focus of the course?
questions.explanation: The learner expected to make something but first studied observation and proportion.

questions.prompt: Which course encouraged participants to use errors productively?
questions.explanation: Mistakes became material for the next question.

questions.prompt: Which course required learners to justify decisions?
questions.explanation: The workshop forced participants to test assumptions and explain choices.

questions.prompt: Which learner noticed progress by comparing records over time?
questions.explanation: Comparing notebook entries revealed a change not noticed in the moment.

questions.prompt: Which account suggests that the social atmosphere affected learning?
questions.explanation: The group took more risks once mistakes were treated differently.

questions.prompt: Which course deliberately avoided giving a full model to copy?
questions.explanation: The instructor supplied a broken programme and no complete demonstration.

questions.prompt: Which learner developed greater precision in questioning?
questions.explanation: The late notebook entries contained more precise questions.

questions.prompt: Which learner found that speed was not the immediate priority?
questions.explanation: The learner wanted to make something quickly but first learned to observe.

questions.prompt: Which account says the most important lesson was not about the stated subject?
questions.explanation: The writer calls the lesson social rather than grammatical.

questions.prompt: Which account would appeal to someone who learns through investigation?
questions.explanation: The workshop centres on testing assumptions and explaining choices.
